**Ultrastable is the foundation for any autonomous system.** Open Questions is a tenant system on it (level 1, parent `ultrastable`).

What science honestly does not know yet: the big open questions, where the evidence leans today, and how that lean has moved.

Idea and system test: `IDEA.md`. Who it is and where it runs: `ultrastable.json`. Manifest: `instance.json`. What could stop it within a year and the safeguard for each: `runway.json`.

| Piece | Code |
|---|---|
| Router, the beat and `/health` | `worker/index.js` |
| Pages (server-rendered, readable without script) | `worker/site.js` |
| What the site states, the page that shows each statement and the endpoint that backs it | `worker/contract.js`, served at `/claims.json` |
| Published open questions | `worker/entries.js`, served at `/api/entries.json` |
| Core files, vendored and refreshed daily | `vendor/ultrastable/` |
| Tests | `npm test` |

Source of the platform: <https://github.com/ultrastable/ultrastable>.
